text: Ranil Wickremesinghe has transferred leadership of Sri Lanka to President Anura Dissanayake.
He expressed gratitude to the people for their mandate in the 21st presidential election.
He described Sri Lanka as a beloved child entrusted to the new president.
The handover occurred following the presidential election held on the 21st.
Anura Kumara Dissanayake received 11,768 postal votes in Polonnaruwa.
Sajith Premadasa received 4,120 votes in the district.
Ranil Wickremesinghe received 2,762 postal votes in Polonnaruwa.
Namal Rajapaksa received 188 postal votes in the district.
Sajith Premadasa received 28,301 votes in Mullaitivu polling division.
He secured 30,877 votes in Medawachchiya polling division.
Results for Bentara-Elpitiya show Dissanayake leading.
Source reports different vote counts and candidates, inconsistent with other reports.
note: meta-comment about sources, not news

text: Police will not issue curfew passes for general travel during the curfew.
Essential and emergency workers can use official ID cards as curfew passes.
The curfew is in effect from 10.00 p.m. tonight to 6.00 a.m. tomorrow.
The curfew was imposed under the Public Security Ordinance following election results.
Curfew extended from 10 p.m. on 21 to 6 a.m. on 22.
note: curfew was extended to 12 noon; 10pm-6am was the original curfew

text: Police will not issue curfew permits during this period.
Essential services may use ID cards as curfew permits.
Curfew extension follows the 9th President's decision.
note: source mentions the 9th presidential election, not a president's decision

text: The National People’s Power (NPP) won 123 seats in the 225-member Parliament.
note: 123 seats was a mid-count figure; final was 159 (stated in the next sentence)

text: The NPP secured a two-thirds majority with 16 seats in Gampaha District.
note: conflates the two-thirds claim with Gampaha's 16 seats

text: The party has 159 seats including 18 national list seats.
This gives NPP a parliamentary majority as it surpassed the 113-seat threshold.
A light truck collided with a train at a railway crossing in Weligama.
The driver disobeyed a red signal at the Polwatte Weligama level crossing.
Seven people, including two children, were injured and hospitalized, some in critical condition.
Election results for Kaludi District have been announced.
note: sources had titles only; 'Kaludi District' is invented (source is Badulla)

text: Results for Kallarikai District were released by Tamil Mirror.
note: 'Kallarikai' is invented; source is Galle district, Akmeemana results

text: Voting results for Pandaraka constituency in Kallarikai District are finalized.
note: Bandaragama is in Kalutara, not 'Kallarikai'

text: No results were reported for Matale District.
note: source 3 IS the Matale result

text: Several former ministers lost their parliamentary seats in the 2024 election.
The election marks a historic shift as long-serving MPs were ousted.
The results show a significant decline in former government representation.
The former MPs were part of a decade-long parliamentary tradition.
note: vague paraphrase of 'MPs who represented parliament for decades'

text: Two former ministers, Manush Nayanakkar and Ramesh Pattirana, lost their parliamentary seats.
note: names garbled (Manusha Nanayakkara, Ramesh Pathirana)

text: They contested seats in the Kali district under the new Janatha Vimukthi Party.
note: they ran for the New Democratic Front in Galle, not 'Janatha Vimukthi Party' in 'Kali'

text: The new Janatha Party did not provide any seat in Kali district to either candidate.
note: garbled party name; the front won no seat in Galle

text: Former President Ranil Wickremesinghe has been summoned to appear at the Criminal Investigation Department (CID).
The summons relates to his visit to London to attend a graduation ceremony for his wife, Professor Maithree Wickremesinghe, during his presidency.
The investigation involves allegations of misusing state funds for a private trip.
He is to be presented before Colombo Fort Magistrate shortly.
MP Rauff Hakeem criticized a YouTuber for prematurely announcing former President Ranil Wickremesinghe’s arrest.
The arrest was confirmed by CID officers after a recorded statement.
The opposition leader Sajith Premadasa questioned how a YouTuber could have known about the arrest in advance.
A suspect died during a shootout with STF in Sooriyawewa.
Two suspects were present; one fled, the other was fatally injured.
STF personnel were injured and hospitalized; one suspect hurled a grenade.
note: one STF officer was injured, not several

text: Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala stated everyone is equal before the law regardless of title or position.
Former President Ranil Wickremesinghe was arrested over alleged misuse of state funds.
He was remanded in custody by Colombo Magistrate’s Court and the case is now before the judge.
Evening thundershowers likely in Northern, North-Central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces.
Heavy rainfall of about 50 mm possible in some areas.
Public advised to take precautions against strong winds and lightning.
Heavy rainfall has caused high water levels in the Kelani River basin.
The Water Resources Department warns of worsening flood conditions in low-lying areas.
note: it is the Irrigation Department

text: A red flood alert has been issued for areas around the Kelani River.
Severe flooding is expected in these regions within the next 48 hours.
All police officers' leave orders suspended due to weather disruptions
Police leave suspended until November 30 due to national emergency conditions
Police officials unable to report to stations due to weather-related issues
note: sources say officers who cannot reach their station may report to the nearest one

text: MP Islam Muttu resigns from Parliament position.
note: name garbled (Ismail Muthu Mohamed)

text: He stepped down from his role during a parliamentary session on 28.
Muttu handed over his resignation letter to Parliament Chairperson Nayanaka Rohan.
note: letter went to Secretary-General Kushani Rohanadeera, not 'Chairperson Nayanaka Rohan'

text: The resignation took effect from 28.
A landslide struck a house in Navalpitikam, killing three people from the same family.
note: place name garbled (Nawalapitiya)

text: The incident occurred during heavy rainfall in the area.
The bodies were taken to the Navalpitikam district hospital.
note: Nawalapitiya divisional hospital

text: This is the fifth death in the region due to weather-related incidents, affecting about 50 families.
note: source says 5 deaths so far in the area, not 'the fifth death'

text: A tropical storm has formed near southern Sri Lanka.
note: storm centre was off the east coast (south of Trincomalee)

text: The storm is centered around 8.1°N, 81.2°E and moving northwest.
It may cause heavy rainfall, strong winds, and flooding across the country.
Sri Lanka's government is preparing for possible damage and considering international aid.
